item.title: Babble, 2025-09-03 07:22 – neurotic platform intellectuals
item.description:
There’s something validating about my ideas about how liberalism is turning everyone into neurotic platformal intellectuals, that whenever I share my philosophical writing somewhere, someone with absolutely no background or prior knowledge of any ideas, will feel comfortable engaging me in a dialog where I must explain every concept in my writing.

An analogy I have is that when I share recordings of my music, people who are not musicians do not suddenly ask me to teach them to play the piece or feel entitled to understand my internal reasoning for why I selected a given key and mode.

item.title: Landrace Philosophy with InfoPonEmacs
item.description:
THE DATE ON THIS IS WRONG, ITS FROM LIKE 2017

I mentioned briefly in my Ko-fi blog post that “I’m going to come back to representing myself, as myself, not focusing on building up a presence for any of the groups I coordinate with.”

That’s a pretty abstract sort of declaration, so I’d like to take some time to explain what exactly I mean by it. I’m hoping that this might be the first in a series of fairly casual posts onto my Ko-fi, that can serve as a kind of re-introduction into who I am and what that means I do, in a more holistic way than just seeing a photo from the garden or a snippet of political thought every three months.
